name: Oskar Thoren
description: I'm a co-founder of EthSystems, where we build confidential systems for institutional Ethereum. Before that I kickstarted and led the Institutional Privacy Task Force at the Ethereum Foundation, where we shipped open source PoCs, specs, and the Ethereum Privacy Map. Earlier I was Head of Engineering at Status and founded Vac, where we built the Waku protocols. I write zkintro, an introduction to zero-knowledge proofs, and have worked on programmable cryptography for about seven years.
